text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026.03.12 -> prod-west (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Canary 5% live. Running postdeploy smoke + synthetic probes now.

Maya: seeing a synth latency spike for embed-service in prod-west, p95 jumped ~10x at +90s. Not huge error rate but latency and some 503s. :warning:

Jon: confirming — dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/d/embeds/prod-west (shortlink). p95 from ~120ms -> ~1.2s, errors ~0.8% on the canary set.

Leo: is this only on canary hosts or the whole region?

Maya: looks constrained to canary subset (5 hosts). regular prod fleet stable so far.

jon: here's a quick probe output I ran against a canary host:
```
$ curl -i https://embed.prod-west.canary.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"kv-cache warmup timeout"}
```

kevin: hmm kv-cache warmup timeout — we rolled a micro change to startup parallelism in v2026.03.12. Could be slower cold-starts for large embedding models.

sre-oncall: also seeing host GPU mem jitter during canary warmup. A few hosts hit higher PCIe stall rates. Correlates with the time window.

Maya: we should pause the rest of rollout and decide: pin to previous stable or rollback canary hosts?

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by request (maya). Remaining hosts will not be upgraded. Options: `rollback v2026.03.12` or `pin-route prod-west -> v2026.02.20`.

kevin: prefer pin-route (traffic pin) to v2026.02.20 for prod-west until we confirm warmup path. Rolling full rollback is heavier. Pinning reduces blast radius and lets us run deeper smoke.

jon: +1 for pin-route. I'll scrub logs and try a targeted repro on a canary host (in parallel).

leo: can we update release notes/announce to customers affected by degraded embed latencies? Might be transient but worth a short note for support.

maya: yes — will add a brief blurb in release notes: "Investigating transient embedding latency increase on v2026.03.12 canaries in prod-west; traffic pinned to previous release for stability."

sre-oncall: created incident ticket INF-4432, assigned to infra and runtime. Added logs and GPU telemetry.

deploy-bot: Executing traffic pin: prod-west -> v2026.02.20 (100%) as requested by kevin. Confirm when you want to unpin.

jon: confirmed pin applied. re-running synth probes against pinned route — latency back to baseline.

maya: thanks. action items: 1) kevin/infra investigate startup parallelism and kv-warm path, 2) jon reproduce on canary host and capture traces, 3) maya update release notes + notify support, 4) sre-oncall continue telemetry and postmortem if needed.

kevin: will open a small RFC for startup change rollback or a safer staged warmup.

leo: label this release as "hold for embed warmup" in the release tracker.

maya: ok closing thread for now. If canary repro is found we may re-run a canary after fix. :thumbsup:
